obligation: G057 -- Matryoshka levels draft and verify each other; TOKEN_NS must fall
verdict: REFUTED ON COST, BEFORE ACCEPTANCE RATE ENTERS. At PERFECT acceptance -- every drafted token kept -- self-speculation is 1.272x SLOWER at K=4 than simply decoding with the verify tier. No acceptance rate rescues a scheme that loses at 100% acceptance. Even the optimistic variant, granting that non-GEMV amortizes K ways when it is per-position work, still loses at 1.128x.
why: The draft is not cheap enough. The 1-plane prefix costs 23.680 ms/token against the q3 verify tier's 31.437 -- only 25% cheaper -- because the codec only moves the GEMV term (25.568 -> 17.811 ms) while non-GEMV sits at 5.869 ms and does not shrink with the representation at all. Speculative decoding needs a draft several times cheaper, not a quarter cheaper.
break_even: For a win at perfect acceptance the draft must cost < 15.063 ms/token at K=4. The cheapest tier measured anywhere in this campaign is 23.378 ms, missing by 1.55x. The non-GEMV floor alone is 5.869 ms and does not shrink with the codec at all.
the_recorded_trap: The campaign's prior result stands and is now explained: 87% acceptance produced 0.91x. Acceptance rate was never the binding variable. The draft-to-verify COST RATIO is, and on this machine it is 0.75 where it needs to be about 0.5 or lower.
what_would_change_it: a draft tier whose NON-GEMV cost is also reduced, not just its GEMV -- the 5.869 ms floor is 25% of the verify tier's entire cost
verify-side amortization better than 2.57x, which the R x K sweep found register-limited
a draft that is a different SHAPE, not merely a cheaper codec of the same shape -- fewer layers or a smaller hidden, which is outside what Matryoshka prefixes provide
data_hygiene_note: An earlier pass of this arithmetic read q3 at 1.251 ps/element from a contaminated run of the codec bench -- the same bad run documented in Q3_LOAD_ALIGNMENT_CONTROL. That inflated the baseline and made speculation look 1.028x rather than 1.255x, and made the optimistic variant look like a WIN at 0.908x. The bench was re-run twice (q3 0.852 both times, 0.0% spread) and CODEC_ALU_COST.json restored before these numbers were taken. Correcting it strengthened the refutation rather than weakening it.
